title: The Girl of Your Dreams is a Demon!
description:
You go to bed with her, your dream girl. She wants to help you rest, to get cosy. You don't need to move, because she's here with you, and she's going to make sure you get the best night's sleep. All you have to do is listen to her lovingly whispering in your ears about how sleepy you are, how you're unable to move.

And then she climbs on top of you, and shows you her true form, her true nature.

She's not your dream girl. She's your sleep paralysis demon, and she's going to have her way with you!

This file has haptic feedback enabled. To set your device up, use this page .

If you don't have one, order a haptic-enabled device from Lovense with my affiliate link to help me out!
author: Mistress Calia
